hypothesis: 'matrixsumlist' names what the ordinary cells become: a list of sums, taken either over the stretches the prime markers cut the stream into or over a board with the prime cells zeroed out.
source_support: SalPhaseIon page: the label 'matrixsumlist' directly follows DBBI (01 section 6).
Creator #8000: 'some characters need to be zeroed out'; #8330: 'prime number is very important'.
Phase 3.2: 'on a sad board but as wide as the first one seen' (14 wide; 84 = 6 x 14).
operand: data/DBBI_91.txt, both complete parses. Ordinary cells a=1..i=9; prime cells are separators (gap lists) or zero (boards, 84 cells only).
operation: Lists: sums of each stretch between markers, with and without the empty stretch; the same restricted to stretches that follow a yellow (be) marker and to those that follow a blue (b) marker; row sums and column sums of the 6x14, 14x6, 7x12 and 12x7 boards. Readings of each list: A1Z26, mod 26 with A=0, mod 26 with A=1, ASCII, ASCII+64, ASCII+96, and the concatenated decimal read as an integer in bytes.

predicted_artifact.detail: One reading of one list is a readable word sequence of at least 8 letters, or a list equals a run of at least 8 of the poster's row or column sums, or a list (as text, digit string or comma list) hashes to an authenticated digest, the DBBI token pattern, or a marker or prize address.

acceptance_rule: PASS on any exact hit, or if the best real quadgram score is above every one of the 4000 control maxima; otherwise NULL. The ten best real outputs are saved for reading.

controls.planted: Ordinary cells constructed so that the 6x14 column sums, prime cells zero, spell 'thisisthepoint' under A1Z26 must be read back exactly and score above every control maximum.
controls.null: 2000 shuffles of the ordinary cells per parse with the markers left in place; the maximum score over all readings of each shuffle.

known_before_sealing: The void first run already showed the real outputs: best score -6.76, below the control median, no exact hit. This rerun exists so that the null rests on a control that fires. The acceptance rule was tightened from the 99.9th percentile to the maximum of the controls; it could not turn that result into a pass.
power_limit: Lists of 12 to 24 values give short strings. An ordinary English phrase of 14 letters scores about -3.6 to -4.6 and the control maximum is about -3.9, so a real but unremarkable short phrase could be missed by the score. The saved top ten are the safeguard.
